title: Rosa Salcedo
body: Level 2 site access, rounds 1 through 6. Distribution logged at the end of each round. Badge void once the road closes. Reverse: call Mum before dark.
rival_reading: Officials could set up exactly this kind of rotating site access at a farm requisitioned as a relief point; a shift log and a closure rule do not by themselves point to program work.
gloss: A rotating site-access card logs distribution rounds that end at road closure.

title: Two Marks, One Job's Mud
body: The map's route is marked twice, the second circle added after the road closed, over a faint curfew stamp. The shovel's tag is signed with initials, not a name; its blade carries a rime of pale residue, dried mud everywhere else.
rival_reading: A relief route could be marked twice for the same reason if the first pass missed something, over an old curfew stamp already printed on the map; a second circle and a muddy blade do not establish a farm program at fault.
gloss: A map route is marked twice over a faint curfew stamp after a road closure, while a tool carries only a trace of residue.
